title: A Declining CVaR Glidepath Framework for Target-Date Fund Design with an Application to the Chilean Pension System
abstract: arXiv:2606.13618v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We propose a framework for designing Target-Date Funds (TDFs) around an explicit return objective while controlling risk directly at the portfolio level through a declining Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR) constraint. In this approach, the regulator or sponsor specifies a CVaR glidepath that gives the portfolio manager enough flexibility to reach a target return with a reasonably high probability. The target return is determined exogenously from pension-design inputs such as retirement age, contribution rate, working years, life expectancy, and replacement-rate goals. This differs from conventional TDF design, where age-dependent asset-class limits are set without an explicit link to a required return.   A key feature of the method is that it does not assume the manager selects an optimal portfolio each period. translated_title: 基于递减CVaR滑行路径的目标日期基金设计框架及其在智利养老金体系中的应用
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一个围绕明确收益目标设计目标日期基金（TDF）的框架，同时通过递减的条件风险价值（CVaR）约束直接在投资组合层面控制风险。在这种方法中，监管机构或发起人设定一条CVaR滑行路径，给予投资组合经理足够的灵活性，使其能够以较高概率实现目标收益。目标收益由养老金设计的外生输入变量确定，例如退休年龄、缴费率、工作年限、预期寿命以及替代率目标。这有别于传统的TDF设计——传统设计中按年龄设定的资产类别限额与所需收益之间没有明确联系。该方法的一个关键特征是不假设经理每期都选择最优投资组合。相反，经理每个月从满足CVaR约束的投资组合集合中抽取一个配置。
tldr: 提出了一种以明确收益目标为核心、通过递减CVaR滑行路径约束在组合层面直接控制风险的目标日期基金设计框架，并应用于智利养老金体系。
en_tdlr: A framework for designing Target-Date Funds around explicit return objectives, controlling risk at the portfolio level via a declining CVaR glidepath constraint, with an application to the Chilean pension system.
